retro-mushroom-lamp.description: A domed shade on a cylindrical base — the classic mushroom-lamp silhouette, sized for a desk or shelf. It is built to light with an LED strip or a small warm bulb, fed up through the hollow base; the light source is not included. Two-part print. Files on Cults3D and Thangs.
retro-mushroom-lamp._note: CONFIRM: intended light source (LED strip vs bulb+socket) and whether the shade needs supports.

apple-watch-charger-mini-stand.description: A small angled block that holds your Apple Watch puck so the watch charges on its side in Nightstand mode, screen facing you. The puck slot is cut for the round Apple charging disc — you thread your own cable and puck in from below. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.

faq.a: The standard round Apple Watch charging puck. The recess holds the disc; the cable runs out the back.

apple-watch-charger-mini-stand._note: CONFIRM: whether the newer/older puck shapes (incl. Series 7 fast charger) both fit the recess.

vintage-crt-monitor-ipad-holder.description: A miniature CRT monitor that stands an iPad mini (6th generation) upright at desk height — a nod to Scott Yu-Jan's Mac Studio iPad dock. A front drawer takes SD cards, a rear drawer holds larger odds and ends, and a top slot keeps a pen or remote. Dimensioned for the iPad mini 6 only; other models need rescaling. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.

faq.a: The iPad mini (6th generation). Other iPad sizes are not dimensioned in the files and would need to be rescaled.

sleek-wave-lamp-jerh.description: A tall, rippling column that reads as a frozen wave. It is built around the separate IKEA lamp cord set / light stand — that part is not printed and not included; the printed shade slides over it. Fit a warm or RGB bulb to taste. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.

faq.a: No. The shade is designed to sit over an IKEA lamp base / cord set, which you buy separately, plus your own bulb.

sleek-wave-lamp-jerh._note: CONFIRM: exact IKEA base/cord product this is built around.

minimal-desk-lamp-jelly-fish-jerh.description: A fluted, domed shade on a slim neck — a jellyfish drifting above the desk. It prints in two pieces, shade and stand, that press together without glue, and the shade is drawn to print in vase / spiralise mode. You add the light: a small bulb holder and bulb, or an IKEA cord set, seats in the base. Files on Cults3D and Thangs.

faq.q: Is a bulb or socket included?
faq.a: No. Fit your own bulb holder and bulb, or drop in an IKEA cord set — the base is hollow to take one.

minimal-desk-lamp-jelly-fish-jerh._note: CONFIRM: exact socket/holder type for the jelly fish base (E14? IKEA cord set only?).

minimal-desk-lamp-corn.description: A softly ridged shade — a corn cob abstracted — on a small cloud-shaped base. Two parts, press-fit, no glue, and the download includes two shade versions to change the light pattern. You supply the bulb and holder. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.

esc-key-cap-lamp.description: An oversized Esc keycap that glows warm from within — a desk light and a keyboard in-joke in one. It prints in parts; the letter is a separate piece you glue to the top face so you can leave it bare or paint it first. Light source not included. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.

faq.q: Does it switch on by pressing the key?
faq.a: No — it is a static shade. Switching is whatever your bulb or LED source uses.

80s-retro-desklamp-with-mac-charger.description: An 80s Japanese-electronics desk lamp with a slot for a MagSafe-style wireless puck, so a phone charges face-up beside it. The body takes a standard E14 lamp socket and bulb — neither is included — and there is a small cut-out for a clock display. Print it, wire in the socket, drop in your charger. Files on Cults3D and Thangs.

faq.q: What do I need to buy separately?
faq.a: A standard E14 lamp socket and bulb, and a slim round MagSafe-style wireless charging puck. None of these are included in the files.

minimal-mesh-lamp-woody-jerh.description: A lattice-shell desk lamp that throws a soft, patterned light. The base accepts an E27 or E14 bulb, and the files also suit the Bambu Lab USB light for a low-voltage build. Bulb and light source are not included. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.

faq.a: An E27 or E14 bulb in the standard base, or a Bambu Lab USB light for a USB-powered build. You supply whichever you use.

ikea-skadis-figure-display-shelf.description: Snap-on shelves for displaying figures and collectibles on a SKÅDIS board. They hold with magnets you press into the print, so shelves lift off and rearrange without tools as your collection grows. Several shelf widths and back patterns are included. Magnets are not supplied. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.

faq.a: Small magnets press into pockets on the back of each shelf and into the matching pegboard clip. You supply the magnets; the pockets are sized in the model.

ikea-skadis-figure-display-shelf._note: CONFIRM: magnet size/diameter the pockets are cut for.

ikea-skadis-accessories-set.description: A discounted three-model bundle: the SKÅDIS Figure Display Shelf, the SKÅDIS Tray Set and the SKÅDIS Minimal Pendant Light. All three clip to the standard 20 mm SKÅDIS pegboard grid and can be printed and rearranged on their own. Buying the set is cheaper than the three designs separately. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.

retro-records-player-charging-station-fo.description: A turntable-shaped dock that charges an iPhone and an Apple Watch side by side, each from your own charger. An internal drawer hides the cables, and the model separates into parts for easier printing and finishing. Chargers and pucks are not included. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.

faq.a: You supply both: a slim round MagSafe-style puck for the phone and a standard Apple Watch charging disc. The recesses are sized for the common Apple-style pucks.

retro-records-player-charging-station-fo._note: CONFIRM: exact puck/charger dimensions the recesses are cut for.

ikea-skadis-hexagon-storage-kit-jerh-2.description: Hexagonal bins in two depths that clip to a SKÅDIS board and tile against each other, so you can grow a honeycomb of storage across the pegboard. Deeper cells for tools and cables, shallow ones for small parts. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.

ikea-skadis-glasses-holder-jerh.description: A tilted tray that holds several pairs of glasses at a 15° angle on a SKÅDIS board, so a pair lifts straight out without knocking the others. The hexagon-cut walls keep the print light — the maker lists roughly 59 g of filament per tray. Clips to the 20 mm grid. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.
ikea-skadis-glasses-holder-jerh._note: CONFIRM: the 59 g/tray figure and the 15° angle before publishing.

ikea-skadis-accessories-kit-vol-2-jerh.description: A discounted bundle of three SKÅDIS models: the Glasses Holder, the Hexagon Storage Kit and the Hexagon Box. All clip to the 20 mm SKÅDIS grid, and the hexagon pieces tile together across the board so you can cover as much area as you need. STL and 3MF project files on Cults3D and Thangs.

ikea-skadis-toy-display-boxes.description: Display cases that snap onto a SKÅDIS board with a support hanger, each with two clear-cut windows for a side view of what is inside. Stack and space them to build a wall display for figures or models. Windows are open cut-outs, not acrylic. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.

ikea-skadis-portable-tool-tote.description: A SKÅDIS tray with a fixed carry handle: hang it on the pegboard between jobs, then lift it off by the handle to carry tools to the bench or another room. One open bay holds hand tools, fasteners and offcuts, and you can stand SKÅDIS hooks or cups next to it on the same board. Prints for the standard 20 mm SKÅDIS hole grid. STL and 3MF files on Cults3D and Thangs.

ikea-skadis-extentsion-boxes.description: Storage boxes with SKÅDIS pegboard holes moulded into their outer faces, so each box becomes mountable board space in its own right. Hang hooks, cups or trays straight off a box, or clip the box to a pegboard and keep building outward from it. Useful where flat wall space has run out. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.

ikea-skadis-desktop-storage-set.description: A vertical SKÅDIS pegboard panel plus a starter set of accessories: two universal hooks, a flat catch-all tray, two pen pots, a memory-card and USB holder, and a phone dock slot. Everything clips to the 20 mm grid and can be moved or swapped as your desk changes. A compact EDC and desk station in one print set. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.

ikea-skadis-multi-device-charging-statio.description: A bedside or desk charging hub for a SKÅDIS board: bays for power bricks and a power bank, channels for cables, a headphone hook and a phone rest — everything charging in one tidy block instead of a cable pile. Chargers and bricks are not included. STL files on Cults3D and Thangs.
